question: What is the ANTONYM for the word ‘priority’ from the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. **"Last".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Priority**: (प्राथमिकता) - The fact or condition of being regarded or treated as more important.

 
 
• **Example**: His first priority is his family.
 
 
 
• **Last**: (अंतिम) - Coming after all others in time or order; final.
 
 
• **Example**: He was the last to arrive at the meeting.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Last".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Factor**: (कारक) - A circumstance, fact, or influence that contributes to a result. 
 
• **Part**: (भाग) - A piece or segment of something such as an object, activity.
 
• **Task**: (कार्य) - A piece of work to be done or undertaken.
